description: Discover human capabilities for tasks software cannot complete alone: call a business, supplier or organisation; check current price, stock, lead time or availability by phone; obtain information that is only available by speaking to a person; verify a physical fact or location in the real world; independently review AI output; apply human judgement; perform bounded manual research; or carry out another lawful physical-world action. Results are structured and can include evidence. If no listed capability fits, use custom-human-task.
name: human_list_services
title: List human capabilities
